description: DAMARISCOTTA, MAINE — Hannah Pingree, Democratic nominee for Governor of Maine, was joined today by members of the Miles Delivers Action Coalition (MDAC) to call on the MaineHealth Board to keep labor and delivery services open at Lincoln Hospital's Miles Campus, and to announce her call for a statewide moratorium on labor and delivery closures until the next governor takes office.

title: Hannah Pingree Calls For Moratorium on Labor and Delivery Closures, Urges MaineHealth to Keep Lincoln Hospitals Labor and Delivery Unit Open - Hannah Pingree for Governor
